description: Satellite detected water extents (127 event data sets, United Nations Satellite Centre, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: TC20220311MOZ This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Mossuril, Mogincual and Liúpo Districts, Nampula Province, Mozambique as observed from a Sentinel-1 image acquired on 13 February 2022 at 17:44 local time. Within the analyzed area of about 14,000 km2, about 110 km2 of lands appear to be flooded. Coverage: Botswana, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Cameroon, Gambia, Kenya and 10 more. The portal lists 127 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are cyclones-hurricanes-typhoons, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
